title: PPG spectral dispersion offers no robust cross-cohort increment for breath-interval variability
abstract: PPG respiratory spectral dispersion did not establish incremental prediction of breath-interval variability across both cohorts. Adding dispersion to rate, heart rate and pulse interval CV reduced log-CV MAE by 0.0041 (95% record-bootstrap CI -0.0071 to 0.0149) in held-out BIDMC records and 0.0320 (0.0063 to 0.0538) in independent CapnoBase. The external gain was not established against a stronger entropy/disagreement baseline. Both datasets were previously exposed; this is exploratory transport, not untouched confirmation.
